policy.limits: Automated OCR and source metadata are screening evidence. Remaining photographs are references, not individually certified pack-size matches. No generated branded packaging. Six mismatches are withheld from the walkthrough without modifying catalogue records.

method: All public references checked for file existence, dimensions, hashes, source metadata and local OCR. Suspect duplicate groups reviewed visually. Reference status does not certify brand, variant or pack-size accuracy. Originals preserved. 256px WebP shelf derivatives; original image only in product detail.
